explanation: This function uses dynamic SQL formatting (.format(w=w, l=l)), which is a CWE-89 anti-pattern, although int(winner) and int(loser) already reject non-integer strings before formatting. If integer validation were removed or bypassed via custom objects, crafted values could alter the INSERT statement. The repair replaces .format() with %s placeholders and passes (w,l) as bound parameters to c.execute().
